metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: You should contact USCIS regarding application issues and/or delays.

metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: USCIS cannot change requested start/end dates nor can they change your completion dates.

metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: If you decide to not pursue your STEM OPT application, you may be able to withdraw your application before it has been processed. We recommend consulting with the ISSC before withdrawing your application.

metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: The average processing time for STEM OPT applications can vary. We recommend checking the USCIS website for current processing times.

metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: If your application is still processing after their currently posted processing times, you may submit a case inquiry with USCIS regarding their delay in processing times.

metadata.chunk_title: While your application is pending with USCIS

facts.value: Biometrics appointments are becoming more common for students applying for Pre-Completion, Post-Completion, and STEM OPT since a USCIS policy update was announced on December 12, 2025. Therefore, USCIS may require you to attend an in-person appointment at a local Application Support Center (ASC) after you submit your application. It is important to monitor your case status and mail closely in case you are scheduled for one.

metadata.chunk_title: Biometrics Appointments for OPT Applicants

facts.value: If you receive an ASC Appointment Notice for biometrics (Form I-797C), review it carefully. The notice will include the date, time, and location of your appointment, as well as details about what you may need to prepare.

metadata.chunk_title: Biometrics Appointments for OPT Applicants

facts.value: It is very important that you attend as scheduled, as missing your appointment could lead to the denial of your application.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Log into your SEVP Portal account and update your current Post-OPT employment. Correct your current employer’s end date. Input your new employer’s information.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Submit a form I-983 for the new STEM employer.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT on the left side bar and choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: For the question 'Is your STEM Extension application still pending with USCIS?' make sure to select 'yes' and then choose the option of 'Change to a new job – STEM OPT still pending' and complete and submit the eForm.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Your SEVIS record will be updated to reflect the reported changes and an updated I-20 will be issued.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: To update USCIS with your change in employment, upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal.
